notes: Rootless-Docker form of the owner runbook in docs/RECORDS-OCR-CONTAINER-ROOTLESS.md. Step IDs and order must match that doc (tested) and check_runbook.py must pass.
rootless_swap.py executes these steps in this order and takes the on_fail path of a failing step. Nothing in CI runs it against Docker.

main.does: check rootless daemon, private dir, names, tag and pause units; save docker inspect; derive mounts and mount users; probe helper image
systemctl --user stop each pause timer, wait for its service to be idle, stop the service
docker stop (never rm) every container using the mounts, including the target and its app-server; confirm quiescence
helper (namespace root, live read-only): baseline manifest, --numeric-owner tar, manifest again, compare
helper: extract tar to isolated copy, sqlite-evidence on the copy only
helper: fresh restore equals baseline; live still equals baseline
write snapshot_ok receipt with archive and backup hashes only if S1-S3 passed
preflight.py, then docker build --pull=false onto the old image ID
docker rename the stopped target to <name>-pre-ocr
create (not start) the replacement from the saved inspect with only the image changed; diff inspect
docker stop the replacement; confirm every mount user stopped
helper: current-state manifest, tar, isolated sqlite-evidence, restore test; hold for owner review if it differs from S1
docker start the replacement while every other user stays stopped
start the other mount users that ran at R1, then the pause timers that were active at R1

RB-A.does: live equals S1 baseline; restore only from a gate-verified archive, otherwise escalate
docker start the unchanged target (image must equal the old image)
start other users that ran at R1, then the pause timers

RB-B.also: set aside a created, never-started replacement
RB-B.does: every mount user stopped; rename a created replacement to <name>-ocr-failed
rename <name>-pre-ocr back; ID and image must equal the recorded ones

RB-C.does: stop pause timers if released, docker stop every mount user including the replacement; confirm
rename the replacement to <name>-ocr-failed; never start it
helper: live manifests against the S1 baseline
for each differing mount: archive current state into the private dir, verify it, clear, extract the S1 archive
live equals the S1 baseline before any start
rename <name>-pre-ocr back; ID and image must equal the recorded ones
docker start the old container; stays running and healthy
